portal_hypertension.title: Ultrasound-Guided Fine-Needle vs. Transjugular Portal Pressure Measurements in Non-Viral, Non-Alcoholic Cirrhosis.
portal_hypertension.journal: Liver international : official journal of the International Association for the Study of the Liver
portal_hypertension.authors: Chen R, Ma L, Liu Y
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：肝静脉压力梯度（HVPG）是诊断病毒性和酒精相关性肝硬化患者临床上显着的门静脉高压的金标准，但其准确性在其他病因学中受到限制。 临床提示：本研究旨在评估非酒精性、非病毒相关性失代偿性肝硬化患者使用细针穿刺 (FN-PVP)、直接门静脉导管测量门静脉压的相关性。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Hepatic venous pressure gradient (HVPG) is the gold standard for diagnosing clinically significant portal hypertension in patients with viral- and alcohol-related cirrhosis, but its accuracy is limited in other aetiologies. This study aimed to evaluate the correlation of portal venous pressure measurements in patients with non-alcoholic, non-viral-related decompensated cirrhosis, using fine-needle puncture (FN-PVP), direct portal vein catheterisation (D-PVP) and wedged hepatic vein balloon occlusion (WHVP). This study retrospectively included patients from the author's centre who simultaneously underwent FN-PVP, HVPG and transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS) placement for vari...

portal_hypertension.title: Effects of zibotentan and dapagliflozin combined in patients with compensated cirrhosis: A randomized placebo-controlled exploratory study.
portal_hypertension.studyType: Journal Article / Randomized Controlled Trial / Clinical Trial, Phase II
portal_hypertension.authors: Garcia-Pagan JC, Gluud LL, Mandorfer M
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床试验。核心观点：内皮素 A (ET A ) 受体拮抗剂可能会降低肝硬化相关的门静脉高压 (PH)。 临床提示：它们与液体潴留有关，钠-葡萄糖协同转运蛋白 2 抑制剂 (SGLT2is) 可能会减轻液体潴留。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Endothelin A (ET A ) receptor antagonists may reduce cirrhosis-associated portal hypertension (PH). They are associated with fluid retention, which might be mitigated by sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2is). Efficacy, safety and tolerability of combining the selective ET A receptor antagonist zibotentan and the selective SGLT2i dapagliflozin were investigated. Patients with compensated cirrhosis (Child-Pugh A) were randomized 1:1 to zibotentan 2.5 mg plus dapagliflozin 10 mg (zibo/dapa) or placebo in a 6-week parallel, double-blind Phase II study.
